거시경제·재정.summary:
이달 1~10일 열흘간의 수출이 같은 기간 기준 역대 최대치를 기록했다. 반도체 수출액만 100억 달러에 육박했다.

관세청은 해당 기간 수출이 213억 달러로 집계됐다고 11일 밝혔다. 지난해 동기 대비 45.3% 증가한 액수다. 수입은 195억 달러로 23.1% 늘었다.

이달 무역수지는 열흘 만에 18억 달러 흑자를 기록하게 됐다. 연간 누적 흑자는 1700억 달러다.

수출을 이끈 것은 역시 반도체였다. 99억5200만 달러로 지난해 같은 기간보다 155.4% 급증했다.

컴퓨터 주변기기(5억8700만 달러·139.5%), 석유제품(19억9700만 달러·65.3%) 등도 지난해보다 수출이 크게 늘었다.

key_headlines.title: South Korea's Q2 Exports Hit Record High of $275.5 Billion Driven by Semiconductor Boom
key_headlines.summary: Semiconductor exports surged 109.8% to $160.4 billion, accounting for 58% of total exports. The top 10 companies' trade concentration reached a historic high of 55.3%.

key_headlines.title: Foreign Property Purchases in Seoul Capital Region Drop by 2,000, Mostly Chinese Buyers
key_headlines.summary: Chinese buyers accounted for 73% of the 2,000-person decline following implementation of foreign land transaction permit system. The policy aims to regulate foreign real estate speculation in capital region.

key_headlines.title: Honam Semiconductor Fab Targeted for First Completion in 2029
key_headlines.summary: Minister Kim Jung-kwan reported government plans to complete the Honam semiconductor fabrication plant by 2029 as part of mega-project initiatives. Dedicated organization will be established within the year to accelerate progress.

key_headlines.title: Korea Development Institute Upgrades Economic Growth Assessment Led by Semiconductor Recovery
key_headlines.summary: KDI diagnosed the Korean economy showing 'expanded improvement trends' centered on semiconductors with concurrent rebounds in exports and consumption. Production and investment also showed significant growth.

key_headlines.title: Seoul Gangnam Area Adds 12,000 Housing Units Through Redevelopment in Five Years
key_headlines.summary: Reconstruction projects in Gangnam's four districts resulted in 51.3% net increase in housing stock, contradicting government perception of limited housing supply effects from redevelopment.

sections.Hot Economy News: South Korea's economy is experiencing strong momentum driven by the semiconductor sector boom. Q2 exports reached a record $275.5 billion, with semiconductor and electronics products jumping 109.8% to $160.4 billion and representing 58% of total exports. The Korea Development Institute has upgraded its economic growth assessment, citing expanded improvement trends across exports, consumption, production, and investment. However, risks remain from high commodity prices, sluggish employment, U.S. tariff concerns, and Middle East instability.
sections.Macro & Fiscal Policy: Global economic conditions show mixed signals as the U.S. Federal Reserve signals potential rate cuts while inflation data remains a key variable for September's FOMC meeting. Europe faces significant economic headwinds with heat waves potentially reducing EU GDP by 1%, equivalent to 295 trillion won in losses, primarily through reduced labor productivity. Australia's central bank maintained its benchmark rate at 4.35%, continuing its tightening stance while assessing the impact of previous rate hikes. U.S. employment data shows potential weakness despite lower unemployment, with wage growth continuing to decelerate below inflation rates.
sections.Financial Markets: South Korean stock markets showed mixed performance with KOSPI attempting recovery but gains remaining limited. The extreme volatility in Korean equities appears to be moderating, with the VKOSPI falling from June highs above 97 to mid-70s in August as leveraged positions unwind. Bloomberg analysis suggests leverage-fueled market overheating is resolving, supported by margin call liquidations and regulatory tightening. Samsung Electronics' rebound helped KOSPI break above the 6,300 mark with 1% gains, while strong semiconductor export data and foreign investor inflows provided support despite elevated oil prices and interest rate pressures.
sections.Industry & Technology: Samsung SDI announced a joint development agreement with General Motors for next-generation rectangular electric vehicle batteries featuring high energy density and fast-charging technology. The North American joint venture will transition to an independent operation. Meanwhile, raw material costs for battery and power supply sectors are surging, with copper prices up 45% and cobalt up 57% due to increased demand from electric vehicle and AI expansion, compounded by South American snowstorms and Congo export restrictions. The government plans to restore overseas investment functions through amendments to the Mining Hazard Control Act.
sections.Real Estate: Seoul's residential rental market is experiencing rapid shifts toward monthly rentals, with monthly lease contracts exceeding 55% of total contracts for the first time. Average monthly rent for Seoul apartments hit a record high of 1.592 million won in June as landlords convert lease agreements to monthly terms. Redevelopment projects continue to prove effective for housing supply, with 12 completed projects in Gangnam's four districts adding 12,000 units in five years. Changes to comprehensive real estate tax rules for 2027 are altering tax strategies for joint-name owners, with couples potentially achieving tax savings by filing separately rather than using single-household exemptions.
sections.International Economy: Hyundai Motor's electric vehicle brand Ioniq is expanding with region-specific strategy models, launching Ioniq 3 for the European market and Ioniq V for China in the third quarter to capture demand in the world's two largest EV markets. Trump Media and Technology Group reported a 340 billion won loss in Q2 while planning to merge with a nuclear fusion company by year-end. Currency markets show the yen weakening despite U.S.-Japan joint intervention, potentially prompting further Japanese rate hikes to narrow the interest rate differential and prevent further yen depreciation.
sections.AI & Economy: Nvidia announced partnerships with six major Wall Street investment firms to expand AI infrastructure investment, with plans to raise up to 500 billion dollars in competitive financing for customer AI data center and computing infrastructure development. Intel launched its first-ever equity offering as a public company to raise 21 trillion won for AI semiconductor development and advanced manufacturing facility expansion. Google surpassed Naver for the first time in mobile user numbers within South Korea, reaching 47.02 million monthly active users compared to Naver's 46.84 million, driven by rapid integration of AI into search services. NHN achieved record Q2 earnings driven by growth in payment and AI cloud services.
sections.Others: Pocheon City launched a local tax arrears management task force to improve collection efficiency and promote sound tax-paying culture. Seoul is offering 22 free educational programs in artificial intelligence, pilates, job retraining, and cultural activities at labor welfare centers for working citizens. GS Engineering & Construction and LS Electric announced collaboration to strengthen competitive advantage in AI data center businesses through advanced power grid infrastructure development. The Korean government is expanding mega-projects including 24.6 trillion won in Central Chungcheong and 107 trillion won in Yeongnam regions to begin implementation within the year.
